_help: Master styling inherited by EVERY embedded widget. Edit a value, then run: tools/deploy-widget.sh ../ai-tools-widget — live everywhere within ~10 min (hard-refresh the lesson). A data- attribute on one embed overrides these for that lesson only.
_crumb_help: crumb = the universal breadcrumb every mobile popup opens with: '{crumb} › {tool}', and tapping it puts the student back on the page they launched the tool from. Keep it ONE emoji. Change it here + deploy = every embed everywhere changes. Set it to "off" to turn breadcrumbs off fleet-wide. Per embed: data-crumb="off" removes it from that embed only; data-crumb="Some Name" shows a custom home-name instead of the icon.
